<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:2">Naz. I, 2</cite> <he>הכביד שַׂעֲרוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="K00030"><he>כָּבֵד</he> I</cite>.

Yoma 47ᵃ קלעי שַׂעֲרִי, v. קֶלַע II; a. fr.—Trnsf. crown, ramification of a tree; panicle, stem and pod of leguminous plants.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:3">Peah II, 3</cite>, a. e. <he>ש׳ כותש</he>, v. <cite ref="K01391"><he>כָּתַשׁ</he></cite>; Y. ib. 17ᵃ top <cite ref="O01297"><he>סֵעָר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:9">Kil. IV, 9</cite> <he>היה הופך ש׳ שתי וכ׳</he> he turned the branches of two rows of vines towards one side; <cite ref="Bava Batra 82b:15">B. Bath. 82ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 21:3">Sabb. XXI, 3</cite> <he>ש׳ של אפונין וש׳ וכ׳</he> the panicles (pods) of beans and of lentils.
